mapper.select: SELECT FROM metal_material r WHERE r.del_flag='0' ORDER BY r.material_id ASC

SELECT FROM metal_material r WHERE r.del_flag='0' AND r.material_code LIKE #{q.codePattern} ESCAPE '!' AND r.material_type =#{q.materialType} AND r.specification LIKE #{q.specificationPattern} ESCAPE '!' AND r.create_time >=#{q.startTime}AND r.create_time <#{q.endExclusive} ORDER BY r.material_id ASC
SELECT FROM metal_material r WHERE r.del_flag='0' AND r.material_id=#{id}
SELECT FROM metal_material r WHERE r.del_flag='0' AND r.material_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE metal_material SET material_code=#{code},material_type=#{materialType},specification=#{specification},version=version+1,update_by=#{updateBy},update_time=NOW() WHERE material_id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND del_flag='0'
UPDATE metal_material SET del_flag='2',version=version+1,update_by=#{actor},update_time=NOW() WHERE material_id=#{id} AND del_flag='0'
